description: A managed host for web apps and APIs from code or a custom container, with staging slots, autoscale and managed certificates.
A serverless container platform built on Kubernetes that scales on traffic or KEDA events, often to zero, without exposing the Kubernetes API.
AWS's container service running tasks without servers to manage; ECS Express Mode provisions the service, load balancer and scaling from an image and two IAM roles.
An immutable version of a container app; Container Apps can split traffic between revisions for blue/green or A/B releases.
A Kubernetes check whose repeated failure makes the kubelet restart the container.
A Kubernetes check whose failure removes the Pod from its Services' endpoints until it recovers, without a restart.
`X-Forwarded-For` and `X-Forwarded-Proto` set by a proxy, applied by `UseForwardedHeaders` so the app sees the original scheme and client IP.
Memory caches, rate-limiter counters, local files and hosted-service schedules that exist separately in every replica of a long-running app.
